24558-watch-the-sky.title: Watch The Sky
24558-watch-the-sky.creator: James H. Schmitz
24558-watch-the-sky.description: A book by James H. Schmitz. The go-chair's wide flexible treads carried it smoothly down the three steps to the sunken section of the living room, Beulah sitting jauntily erect in it, for all the ninety-six years which had left her the last survivor of the original group of Earth settlers on the world of Roye.

arxiv-2007-14217.title: Dimensional analysis in relativity and in differential geometry
arxiv-2007-14217.creator: P.G.L. Porta Mana Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, Bergen <portamana.org>
arxiv-2007-14217.description: Abstract This note provides a short guide to dimensional analysis in Lorentzian and general relativity and in differential geometry. It tries to revive Dorgelo and Schouten’s notion of ‘intrinsic’ or ‘absolute’ dimension of a tensorial quantity. The intrinsic dimension is independent of the dimensions of the coordinates and expresses the physical and operational meaning of a tensor.

arxiv-2102-11801.title: Decentralized Joint Beamforming, User Scheduling and QoS Management in 5G and Beyond Systems
arxiv-2102-11801.creator: Roberto P. Antonioli, Gábor Fodor, Pablo Soldati, Tarcisio F. Maciel
arxiv-2102-11801.description: Abstract Fifth generation cellular systems support a broad range of services, including mobile broadband, critical and massive Internet of Things and are used in a variety of scenarios. In many of these scenarios, the main challenge is maintaining high throughput and ensuring proper quality of service (QoS) in irregular topologies.

arxiv-2111-03990.title: Maximizing Unambiguous Velocity Range in Phase-contrast MRI with Multipoint Encoding
arxiv-2111-03990.creator: Shen Zhao, Rizwan Ahmad, Lee C. Potter
arxiv-2111-03990.description: Abstract In phase-contrast magnetic resonance imaging (PC-MRI), the velocity of spins at a voxel is encoded in the image phase. The strength of the velocity encoding gradient offers a trade-off between the velocity-to-noise ratio (VNR) and the extent of phase aliasing. Phase differences provide invariance to an unknown background phase.

arxiv-2210-00805.title: Limitations of neural network training due to numerical instability of backpropagation
arxiv-2210-00805.creator: Clemens Karner, Vladimir Kazeev, Philipp Christian Petersen
arxiv-2210-00805.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Clemens Karner, Vladimir Kazeev, Philipp Christian Petersen. We study the training of deep neural networks by gradient descent where floating-point arithmetic is used to compute the gradients. In this framework and under realistic assumptions, we demonstrate that it is highly unlikely to find ReLU neural networks that maintain, in the course of training with gradient descent, superlinearly many affine pieces with respect to their number of layers.

arxiv-2301-07656.title: Non-parametric identifiability and sensitivity analysis of synthetic control models Research done while author was an intern at Spotify
arxiv-2301-07656.creator: Jakob Zeitler, Athanasios Vlontzos, Ciaran M. Gilligan-Lee
arxiv-2301-07656.description: Abstract Quantifying cause and effect relationships is an important problem in many domains. The gold standard solution is to conduct a randomised controlled trial. However, in many situations such trials cannot be performed. In the absence of such trials, many methods have been devised to quantify the causal impact of an intervention from observational data given certain assumptions.

arxiv-2402-01801.title: Large Language Models for Time Series: A Survey
arxiv-2402-01801.creator: Xiyuan Zhang, Ranak Roy Chowdhury, Rajesh K. Gupta, Jingbo Shang
arxiv-2402-01801.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have seen significant use in domains such as natural language processing and computer vision. Going beyond text, image and graphics, LLMs present a significant potential for analysis of time series data, benefiting domains such as climate, IoT, healthcare, traffic, audio and finance.

arxiv-2402-06628.title: Stellar populations of massive early-type galaxies observed by MUSE 2024 Stellar populations of massive early-type galaxies observed by MUSE – 24
arxiv-2402-06628.creator: Taniya Parikh, Roberto Saglia, Jens Thomas, Kianusch Mehrgan, Ralf Bender, Claudia Maraston
arxiv-2402-06628.description: Abstract Stellar population studies of massive early-type galaxies (ETGs) suggest that the stellar initial mass function may not be universal. In particular, the centres of ETGs seem to contain an excess of low-mass dwarf stars compared to our own Galaxy. Through high resolution MUSE IFU data, we carry out a detailed study of the stellar populations of eight massive ETGs.

arxiv-2411-08697.title: Local generation of tilings
arxiv-2411-08697.creator: Juliette Favereau and Mathieu Hoyrup
arxiv-2411-08697.description: Abstract In this article, we investigate the possibility of generating all the configurations of a subshift in a local way. We propose two definitions of local generation, explore their properties and develop techniques to determine whether a subshift satisfies these definitions. We illustrate the results with several examples.

arxiv-2602-06301.title: Design-Conditional Prior Elicitation for Dirichlet Process Mixtures: A Unified Framework for Cluster Counts and Weight Control
arxiv-2602-06301.creator: JoonHo Lee
arxiv-2602-06301.description: Abstract . Dirichlet process mixture (DPM) models are widely used for semiparametric Bayesian analysis in educational and behavioral research, yet specifying the concentration parameter remains a critical barrier. Default hyperpriors often impose strong, unintended assumptions about clustering, while existing calibration methods based on cluster counts suffer from computational inefficiency and fail to control the distribution of mixture weights.

europmc-pmc3591697.title: Synchronization and desynchronization in epilepsy: controversies and hypotheses.
europmc-pmc3591697.creator: Jiruska P, de Curtis M, de Curtis M, Jefferys JG, Schevon CA, Schiff SJ, Schindler K.
europmc-pmc3591697.description: Epilepsy has been historically seen as a functional brain disorder associated with excessive synchronization of large neuronal populations leading to a hypersynchronous state. Recent evidence showed that epileptiform phenomena, particularly seizures, result from complex...

pmc-10555104.creator: Jaymilitte Bosques-Lorenzo, Jose J Irizarry-Garcia, Joedali Baez-Torres, Janet Colon-Castellano
pmc-10555104.description: Disclosure: J. Bosques-Lorenzo: None. J.J. Irizarry-Garcia: None. J. Baez-Torres: None. J. Colon-Castellano: None. Background: Starvation ketoacidosis is a rare cause of metabolic acidosis that is often under-recognized. To our knowledge, no cases of starvation ketoacidosis secondary to colitis and gastritis have been reported.

pmc-10638001.title: The concept of reasons for eliminating corporate crime in criminal law in Indonesia
pmc-10638001.creator: Randikha Prabu Raharja Sasmita, Sigid Suseno, Patris Yusrian Jaya
pmc-10638001.description: Following Indonesian criminal law, courts may not find defendants or offenders guilty for various grounds known as illegal abolition reasons. There are two justifications and grounds for forgiveness for abolishing crimes under the Indonesian Criminal Code. The justification for abolishing this punishment is solely applicable to human legal subjects.

pmc-10650609.title: Improved Resistive and Synaptic Characteristics in Neuromorphic Systems Achieved Using the Double-Forming Process
pmc-10650609.creator: Minkang Kim, Dongyeol Ju, Myounggon Kang, Sungjun Kim, Seiichi Miyazaki, Wei Wu
pmc-10650609.description: In this study, we investigate the electrical properties of ITO/ZrOx/TaN RRAM devices for neuromorphic computing applications. The thickness and material composition of the device are analyzed using transmission electron microscopy. Additionally, the existence of TaON interface layers was confirmed using dispersive X-ray spectroscopy and X-ray photoelectron analysis.

pmc-11619669.title: Anxiety and depression as potential risk factors for limited pain management in patients with elderly knee osteoarthritis: a cross-lagged study
pmc-11619669.creator: Wenhao Yang, Guangyuan Ma, Jingchi Li, Taiyuan Guan, Dingchang He, Dujiang Yang, Guoyou Wang, Hui Shi
pmc-11619669.description: BackgroundPain management for knee osteoarthritis (KOA) patients is challenging. Pain arises from both physiological and psychological interactions, with anxiety and depression potentially contributing as risk factors that hinder effective pain management in KOA patients.MethodsBefore treatment(T1), A total of 206 elderly inpatients with KOA were enrolled based on initial screening criteria.

pmc-12577546.title: Retroperitoneal Lipomatosis
pmc-12577546.creator: Floriane Bootsma, Adelard De Backer
pmc-12577546.description: Teaching point: Retroperitoneal lipomatosis is a benign idiopathic process resulting in a progressive, symmetrical and homogeneous increased retroperitoneal fat lesion without areas of increased density.Keywords: CT, retroperitoneal lipomatosis Case History A 71-year-old woman presented with vague, non-specific, diffuse abdominal pain and gradual abdominal distension for several years.

pmc-12603030.title: Effective of prompt and delayed gamma emission on the nuclear radiation shielding effectiveness of prevalent natural minerals
pmc-12603030.creator: Islam M Nabil, Said M Kassem, A F El-Sayed, Soliman M El-Talawy, Atef El-Taher
pmc-12603030.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study aims to explore the neutron and emphasizing gamma emission (prompt and delayed) radiation attenuation capabilities of the different natural minerals, including Magnetite, Rutile, Ilmenite, and concrete NBS materials. The Monte Carlo N–Particle simulation code (MCNP) and the EpiXs software (EpX) have been used to inspect the studied compounds against neutrons associated with secondary energetic γ-rays at the range 0.03–15 MeV of energy through different thicknesses 2–12 cm.

pmc-12808727.title: A spatiotemporal transformer with cross-frame encoding and trajectory-aware decoding for multi-target fish tracking
pmc-12808727.creator: Yang Li, Lei Han
pmc-12808727.description: In response to the challenges of multi-object fish tracking in complex underwater environments, where performance is easily affected by illumination changes, suspended particles, occlusion, and high inter-target visual similarity, this paper proposes a unified Transformer framework that integrates cross-frame spatiotemporal encoding with trajectory-aware decoding.

pmc-13075533.title: An Attempt to Establish the Consensus Regarding the Diagnosis, Classification, and Treatment of Rosacea in Japan Using a Modified Delphi Method: The Japan Rosacea Consensus
pmc-13075533.creator: Kenshi Yamasaki, Nobukazu Hayashi, Hiroaki Hayashi, Yasuko Fukuya, Yuki Horiuchi, Miwa Kobayashi, Yoshimasa Nobeyama, Jun Omatsu, Kanako Tsunoda, Yoshiki Miyachi
pmc-13075533.description: In Japan, rosacea has attracted increasing interest. However, because rosacea had been thought to be relatively rare in Japan, the perception of this disease varies among dermatologists. To address these challenges, this study developed a consensus regarding the diagnosis, classification, and treatment of rosacea using a modified Delphi method based on the expertise of Japanese specialists in rosacea.

pmc-13557758.title: Longitudinal Outcomes of Total Hip Arthroplasty in Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip: A National Database Propensity-Matched Analysis
pmc-13557758.creator: Malik Al-Jamal, Omar Abdalla, Ahmad Hasan, Abdelrahman Diab, Omar Diab, Muhammad Waheed, Dalia Abudaya, Khaled J. Saleh, Walid Yassir
pmc-13557758.description: Introduction:Developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) complicates total hip arthroplasty (THA) due to altered anatomy and biomechanics, increasing surgical complexity and postoperative risks. Although its effect on THA outcomes has been studied, data on long-term implant performance and revision surgery rates remain limited.
